title: Taxi Time Creep by Airport
dataSources: Pilot logbook (`flightlog:entry`), avionics telemetry (`avionics:telemetry`), flight-sim sessions (`flightsim:session`), pre-flight checklists (`preflight:check`).
app: Pilot and flight-sim telemetry — electronic logbooks (ForeFlight, LogTen Pro), Stratux / GDL90 avionics receivers, and Microsoft Flight Simulator / X-Plane SimConnect sessions — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flightlog:entry departure_airport=*
| stats avg(taxi_out_min) as avg_taxi_out, avg(taxi_in_min) as avg_taxi_in, count as flights by departure_airport
| sort - avg_taxi_out
description: Shows which airports or routines are adding the most ground-time creep before takeoff.
value: Taxi-time creep matters for fuel planning, schedule realism, and total cost even if the flight itself is short.
implementation: Capture taxi-in and taxi-out minutes in `index=personal`; compare averages by departure airport.
visualization: Airport table of average taxi-out and taxi-in minutes.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces which airports are adding the most extra ground time before or after the part of flying you actually care about.
